build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball above a hole between two angled bars
add_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with a given scale, angle, and position in the scene
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object at a specified height and horizontal center in the scene
update_task_relationship: define a task goal requiring a ball to be placed inside a jar using spatial relationships
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to the PRE_TWO_BALLS solution tier for difficulty classification
